elements.name: mpeg.open
elements.description: Open a video for decoding. MPEG1 (.mpg) or AV1 in an IVF file (.ivf), recognized by its header.

parameters.name: video
parameters.doc: The video data as a buffer or string. Ownership of the buffer is not transferred.

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: Optional video settings. `loop` loops the video. `format` is "rgb" (default, frames converted to RGB on the CPU) or "yuv" (packed YUV planes for the video_yuv shader). `decode_ahead` (AV1, default true) decodes on a worker thread into a queue. `threads` (AV1) sets the decoder threads, by default 1 up to 1080p, 2 up to 1440p and 4 above. `audio` (MPEG1) makes this decoder decode the audio track too, but the samples are not played - use decode_audio() and a sound component for sound.

returnvalues.name: handle
returnvalues.doc: Returns video handle. Use in subsequent calls.

returnvalues.name: err
returnvalues.doc: Error message if video failed to open.

elements.name: mpeg.close
elements.description: Close an opened video. This will release an memory allocated by the videoplayer.

elements.name: mpeg.decode
elements.description: Advance the internal timer by seconds and decode video/audio up to this time.

returnvalues.name: has_new_frame
returnvalues.doc: Returns true if decode produced at least one new video frame.

elements.name: mpeg.write
elements.description: Write data to the internal stream buffer of a video started with stream(). Use the `streaming_buffer_bytes_remaining` and `streaming_buffer_capacity` to determine how much data to write to the buffer.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.doc: The video handle to write to.

returnvalues.name: bytes_written
returnvalues.doc: The number of written bytes or nil if writing failed.

returnvalues.name: error
returnvalues.doc: Error message if writing failed for some reason.

elements.name: mpeg.seek
elements.description: Seek to the specified time. Will seek to the last intra frame just before the desired time.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.doc: The video handle to seek on.

parameters.name: seek_exact
parameters.doc: If value is true the function will seek to the exact time, otherwise it will seek to the last intra frame just before the desired time. Exact seeking can be slow, because all frames up to the seeked one have to be decoded on top of the previous intra frame. Defaults to false.

elements.name: mpeg.get_frame
elements.description: Get the video frame buffer. The video frame buffer will be updated when decode() is called and enough data has been decoded to produce a frame.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.doc: The video handle to get frame buffer for.

returnvalues.name: frame
returnvalues.doc: The decoded video frame buffer or nil if no video frame buffer is available. The ownership of the buffer is not transferred to the caller.

elements.name: mpeg.get_frame_serial
elements.description: Get a monotonically increasing serial number for decoded video frames.

returnvalues.name: serial
returnvalues.doc: The serial number of the latest decoded frame.

elements.name: mpeg.get_time
elements.description: Get the current playback time of a video. Same as get_info().time, without creating a table.

elements.name: mpeg.decode_audio
elements.description: Decode the whole MPEG audio track of a video, or of an audio-only MPEG file, into a 16-bit stereo PCM WAV file in memory, ready for resource.set_sound() or resource.create_sound_data(). Uses its own decoder, so an opened video handle is not affected.

parameters.name: video
parameters.doc: The video data as a buffer or string.

returnvalues.name: wav
returnvalues.doc: The WAV file, or nil if the video has no audio track.

returnvalues.name: info
returnvalues.doc: Table with `samplerate`, `channels`, `duration` (exact, in seconds) and `decode_ms`, or an error message if wav is nil.

elements.name: mpeg.get_info
elements.description: Get information about an opened video.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.doc: The video to get info for.

fields.name: codec
fields.doc: "mpeg1" or "av1".

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Video width.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Video height.

fields.name: bytes_per_pixel
fields.doc: The number of bytes per pixel.

fields.name: framerate
fields.doc: The frame rate (frames per second) of the video stream.

fields.name: samplerate
fields.doc: The sample rate (samples per second) of the audio stream.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Current playback time in seconds.

fields.name: duration
fields.doc: Estimated duration in seconds - the span between the first and the last timestamp in the file. Accurate on long videos, can be short by up to a second on short clips.

fields.name: convert_ms
fields.doc: Time the last frame took to convert to RGB or copy as YUV planes, in milliseconds.

fields.name: format
fields.doc: "rgb" or "yuv", as passed to open().

fields.name: texture_width
fields.doc: Width of the frame buffer. For "yuv" it is larger than the video.

fields.name: texture_height
fields.doc: Height of the frame buffer. For "yuv" it is larger than the video.

fields.name: matrix
fields.doc: "bt601" or "bt709": the YUV to RGB matrix of the video. For AV1 known after the first frame.

fields.name: full_range
fields.doc: Whether the video uses full range YUV instead of limited (studio) range.

fields.name: threads
fields.doc: AV1 only - number of decoder threads.

fields.name: queue_frames
fields.doc: AV1 only - size of the decode-ahead queue, 0 when decoding synchronously.

fields.name: decode_ms
fields.doc: AV1 only - how long the last frame shown took to decode, in milliseconds.

fields.name: is_looping
fields.doc: If the video is looping or not.

fields.name: is_streaming
fields.doc: If the video is opened in streaming mode.

fields.name: eos
fields.doc: If the video has reached the end of stream.

fields.name: streaming_buffer_bytes_remaining
fields.doc: The number of unread bytes remaining in the stream buffer when streaming.

fields.name: streaming_buffer_capacity
fields.doc: The capacity of the stream buffer in bytes.
